en.hubeali:
Ibn Mahboub, from Hammad Abu Yusuf Al Khaaz, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘When there was an inheritor from the one for him is an Obligation (legislated share), so he is more deserving of the wealth’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ibn Mahbub from Hammad abu Yusuf al-Khazzaz from Sulayman ibn Khalid who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’
Amir al-Mu’minin would say, ‘An heir who has an ordained share is more deserving of the legacy.’”
